adaptations: Maps TAXJAR_LIST_TAX_CATEGORIES to documented GET /v2/categories. Healthcheck uses the same path for token verification.
Maps TAXJAR_CREATE_CUSTOMER to documented POST /v2/customers. exemption_type enum is wholesale, government, other, or non_exempt.
Maps TAXJAR_DELETE_CUSTOMER to documented DELETE /v2/customers/{customer_id}.
customerId is a required path segment on GET /customers/{customer_id}.
Returns raw TaxJar JSON under data. Optional page (>=1) and per_page (1-100) use official query names.
Maps TAXJAR_UPDATE_CUSTOMER to documented PUT /v2/customers/{customer_id}. Path uses origin customerId; body uses official field names.
Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /v2/categories, which official auth docs recommend for token verification and which is not a billed calculation or rate lookup.
Native sends Authorization Bearer and x-api-version: 2022-01-24 (current official version and pinned source). Official also documents Token token= auth; native follows Bearer as in pinned executors.
Native category is accounting: TaxJar is sales-tax compliance. Source Finance/Data are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.
Returns raw TaxJar JSON under data. The upstream user-agent and GET Content-Type are not sent. POST /taxes and GET /rates/{zip} are omitted because they count toward billed API transactions.
Returns raw TaxJar JSON under data from GET /nexus/regions.
Maps TAXJAR_CREATE_ORDER_TRANSACTION to documented POST /v2/transactions/orders.
Maps TAXJAR_DELETE_ORDER_TRANSACTION to documented DELETE /v2/transactions/orders/{transaction_id}.
Maps TAXJAR_SHOW_ORDER_TRANSACTION to documented GET /v2/transactions/orders/{transaction_id}. Optional provider query defaults to api upstream.
fromTransactionDate and toTransactionDate are required YYYY-MM-DD query values matching official from_transaction_date and to_transaction_date. Optional provider is forwarded when set.
Maps TAXJAR_UPDATE_ORDER_TRANSACTION to documented PUT /v2/transactions/orders/{transaction_id}. Path uses origin-style transactionId.
Maps TAXJAR_SHOW_TAX_RATES_FOR_A_LOCATION to documented GET /v2/rates/{zip}. This endpoint counts toward billed API transactions.
Optional country, state, city, and street query params are omitted when unset.
Maps TAXJAR_CREATE_REFUND_TRANSACTION to documented POST /v2/transactions/refunds. transaction_reference_id is required.
Maps TAXJAR_DELETE_REFUND_TRANSACTION to documented DELETE /v2/transactions/refunds/{transaction_id}.
Maps TAXJAR_SHOW_REFUND_TRANSACTION to documented GET /v2/transactions/refunds/{transaction_id}.
Maps TAXJAR_LIST_REFUND_TRANSACTIONS to documented GET /v2/transactions/refunds using the same date aliases as origin orders.list.
Maps TAXJAR_UPDATE_REFUND_TRANSACTION to documented PUT /v2/transactions/refunds/{transaction_id}. transaction_reference_id is required by official docs.
Maps TAXJAR_SUMMARIZE_TAX_RATES_FOR_ALL_REGIONS to documented GET /v2/summary_rates.
Maps TAXJAR_CALCULATE_SALES_TAX_FOR_AN_ORDER to documented POST /v2/taxes. This endpoint counts toward billed API transactions.
Required fields follow official docs: to_country, to_zip, to_state, shipping. amount or line_items is required by TaxJar at runtime.
Optional nexus_addresses and line_items are omitted when unset.

Maps TAXJAR_VALIDATE_VAT_NUMBER to TaxJar GET /v2/validation?vat= as used by official clients (taxjar-node/php validate). Current public reference emphasizes address validation; VAT remains a Composio tool.

incidents.remediation: Stripe switched invite deletion to invitation ID scoped to the organization.
incidents.residualRisk: Historical; not an unpatched TaxJar API compromise.
incidents.status: confirmed historical web-app vulnerability; resolved by Stripe

incidents.remediation: Stripe validated the reset-password token against the user being reset instead of a URL account ID.
incidents.residualRisk: Historical; not an unpatched TaxJar API compromise.
incidents.status: confirmed historical web-app vulnerability; resolved by Stripe

research.searchCoverage: Official TaxJar API v2, Stripe ownership, billed calculation/rate lookups, and 2022 HackerOne ATO remediation reviewed on 2026-09-13. This is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

selection.edition: international TaxJar Sales Tax API v2 Composio parity

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.incident: 2022 HackerOne reports #1581240 (invite-token ATO) and #1685970 (email-change ATO) against app.taxjar.com. Stripe summarized both as improper access control and marked them resolved.
exception.remediation: Stripe/TaxJar patched the invite-token and password-reset account-takeover bugs in 2022 and paid bounties. These were web-app IDOR issues, not an unpatched TaxJar API compromise.
exception.residualRisk: Historical web-app ATO is remediated. Live TaxJar API authentication is unverified. POST /taxes and GET /rates/{zip} count toward billed API transactions; they are included because they are Composio tools.
exception.usefulness: Composio TAXJAR tools (21) plus AppCall healthcheck: categories, nexus, customers, order/refund transactions, tax calculation, rate lookup, summarized rates, and VAT validation.

selection.ownership: TPS Unlimited, Inc. d/b/a TaxJar, a wholly owned subsidiary of Stripe, Inc.; US sales-tax API at api.taxjar.com. Not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official TaxJar Sales Tax API v2 (Bearer or Token auth, https://api.taxjar.com/v2, x-api-version 2022-01-24, GET /categories recommended for token verification, GET /nexus/regions, GET /customers, GET /transactions/orders, calculations and rate lookups billed as transactions), Stripe/TaxJar US identity, and dated incident search (TaxJar + security breach/incident). Historical 2022 HackerOne account-takeover bugs on app.taxjar.com were disclosed and resolved; no qualifying current unresolved TaxJar API customer-data compromise was identified. This is not a breach-free claim.
